1000	we said earlier that if it had come from Moshe Rabbeinu

1001	alone and from faith alone, it would not be through the birur from below;

1002	it would be only from Above. Yet the ultimate purpose

1003	is that there be a birur from below.

1004	Now, what is the benefit of the birur

1005	from below? Why is it so important to the Holy One, blessed be He,

1006	that it come from below? Why not

1007	from above? When you get up in the morning and the sun is shining, the whole

1008	world is full of light and you rise to a new, radiant day,

1009	does it bother you that the light comes from above and not from below?

1010	Who would it bother at all? On the other hand, in our

1011	personal experience as human beings, if you only receive

1012	gifts, how will you feel? You won't feel satisfied.

1013	You'll feel a lack of taste in everything given to you, because a person wants

1014	his own portion more than a whole measure of his fellow's. That is to say,

1015	in the end there is indeed a completeness that comes from below. And what

1016	is this completeness?

1017	This completeness is hinted at in Rashi's words about

1018	the spies. When the Torah lists their names, it says:

1019	"Moshe sent men." What is "men"? Rashi says:

1020	important people, an expression of importance. And why all of them men? Because

1021	they truly were the most important in the people of Israel, the most select,

1022	the chosen team. But they were such great sinners

1023	later in the Parashah. Rashi says: to teach you that at that

1024	time they were kesherim. What is "kesher"? The Rebbe asks: why not

1025	tzaddikim? Say they were tzaddikim. What is "kesherim"? The

1026	Rebbe says kasher is an acronym for "as one who finds great

1027	spoil." What is spoil? It is what you bring from the enemy. If

1028	you stay home and do not make war with the enemy, then

1029	you may sit under your vine and under your

1030	fig tree, but great spoil you will not have. But if you go out

1031	to fight with

1032	the enemy, even though the enemy puts you at

1033	high risk and a high price, and here is the price they paid,

1034	those who remained

1035	in the desert. But with all this price, what is the final gain?

1036	Great spoil. And what is the great spoil? The great spoil is that only in such

1037	a situation, where the birur from below is done,

1038	is the intention of HaShem revealed. And what is revealed in HaShem's intention?

1039	That which the spies did not even manage to grasp.
